markets.name: United States Oil Fund • Robinhood Token

peerMapping.justification: CL is compared against a narrow set of assets that share identifiable channels rather than a generic basket. BRENTOIL is the hedge because it is the nearest crude benchmark to WTI while isolating the WTI-Brent basis. The peer sleeve is tilted toward energy substitution and supply-shock exposure through NATGAS, real-asset and risk-off inflation exposure through GOLD and SILVER, and the global growth demand channel through COPPER and SP500. TSLA is kept small because electrification can substitute away from oil demand while the equity still shares risk-on sentiment. Weights are positive, sum to exactly 1, and respect displayed 24-hour perp liquidity stated in USD millions by giving more weight to deep, economically aligned markets and less weight to channels that are approximately comparable rather than direct oil replacements.

peers.name: Natural gas
peers.reason: Natural gas is a peer through the shared energy complex, including heating and power-generation substitution, inventory dynamics, weather-sensitive demand, and geopolitical supply risk. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.186 USD millions, lower than the other peers, so the strong energy linkage is balanced against thinner liquidity.

peers.name: Gold
peers.reason: Gold is a peer through macro factors that affect the broader commodity complex, especially inflation expectations, real interest rates, US-dollar direction, and risk-off demand. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 23.982 USD millions.

peers.name: Copper
peers.reason: Copper is a peer because oil and copper both respond to global industrial production, expected economic growth, China-linked demand, broad commodity-cycle positioning, and US-dollar movements. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 6.262 USD millions.

peers.name: S&P 500
peers.reason: SP500 is a peer because WTI often reacts to broad risk-on/risk-off positioning and changing expectations for aggregate economic activity. It has comparatively high displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 50.729 USD millions, but it receives a lower weight because it is a general macro proxy rather than a direct energy or commodity-sector peer.

peers.name: Silver
peers.reason: Silver mixes precious-metal inflation protection with industrial demand, so part of its return can move with the same real-rate and growth shocks as oil even though it is not an energy substitute. Its displayed liquidity is 32.581 USD millions.

primary_index_hedge.name: Brent crude oil
primary_index_hedge.reason: Brent is the closest crude benchmark to WTI, sharing refinery demand, OPEC supply, inventory, and shipping-risk drivers while leaving mainly the WTI-Brent basis. Its displayed liquidity is 36.44 USD millions versus CL at 40.091 USD millions.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
